event: Probably these are generic register-reset/access tests. Check specific counters.

I verified the finding: all five items are untested, and the verdict was accepted.

The four counter register names from the items (`notif_mbox0_target_done_intr_count_r`, `notif_mbox0_soc_req_lock_intr_count_r`, `error_mbox0_ecc_unc_intr_count_r`, `notif_cptra_mbox_cmd_avail_intr_count_r`) appear only in three files. Those are `mci_reg.sv`, `mci_reg_uvm.sv` and `mci_top_cov_if.sv`, which are RTL, the UVM register model and a coverage interface. No test increments or reads any of the counters, and nothing checks saturation.

The only test-suite hit for `intr_count` is an unrelated local C variable in `cptra_ss_mcu_mbox_test.c`. I recorded it as a near miss.

The search covered `.c`, `.h`, `.sv`, `.svh`, `.py`, `.yml` and `.tcl` files. I did not search other file types, so a check in something like a Makefile or log-compare script would not have shown up.
